figures.caption: Paired series-macro joint-loss differences. Positive values favor Full. Intervals are percentile 95% intervals from 10,000 paired series bootstrap draws after averaging seed differences; development and Rio are resampled separately. Open markers identify intervals containing zero. Blue denotes task-adapted architecture baselines; purple denotes frozen component references. Every comparison is shown.

Series-level joint-loss differences after averaging the fitted seed scores. Each column is one held-out HLTV series. Positive (blue) cells favor Full and negative (red) cells favor the reference. Both cohorts use the same symmetric, unclipped color scale; all series and all comparators are retained.

Temporal and mark contributions to joint log loss, using the same cutoff–round–series aggregation and mean of seed scores. The vertical contribution equals joint minus temporal NLL, including zero contribution at no-event-tail targets. Dashed diagonals represent constant joint loss. Points are score means, not confidence regions or causal effects.
